title: confirm.request
description: A tool with confirm set is about to run and the platform is asking the caller. The agent reads the phrase; nothing runs until confirm.granted.

ConfirmRequest.description: A tool with confirm set is about to run and the platform is asking the caller. The agent reads the phrase; nothing runs until confirm.granted.

tool.description: The tool waiting for a yes.

arguments.description: The arguments the yes will be bound to.

audience.description: sha256 of tool plus canonical arguments: the one thing the token will be good for.

phrase.description: What the agent reads back: the action in the caller's words.

ttl_s.description: How many seconds the caller has to answer before the request lapses.
